integrity: Symbolic proof supported by direct labelled finite-extension enumeration and independent arithmetic tests; no claim of external proof certification.
scientific_limitations: Valid for complete bipartite induced named bases with both parts positive in a fixed K_m-free Henson graph, m>=4; not a theorem for arbitrary base graphs. Inverse recovers part sizes, not named vertex identifications. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp arity threshold for recovering biclique parameters in Henson graphs
